explanation: Swiss men voted in February 1971 to let women vote nationally. The last holdout canton, Appenzell Innerrhoden, admitted women to its local votes only in 1990, on a court's orders.

claims.text: Yuri Gagarin became the first person in space on 12 April 1961.
Swiss women gained the right to vote in federal elections after a referendum of male voters on 7 February 1971.
The Federal Supreme Court of Switzerland ruled in 1990 that Appenzell Innerrhoden must allow women to vote in cantonal matters.
Appenzell Innerrhoden was the last Swiss canton to give women the vote on local matters.
